one_liner.zh: 本周加密与传统呈「加密偏独立」：BTC 窗口约 -2.0% 落在偏震荡，杠杆中性，实现波动中等而期权相对 RV 偏贵；现货 ETF 合计净流出收窄至 -2.28 亿美金，通道中性拉锯。
one_liner.en: Crypto read as idiosyncratic vs TradFi: BTC window ~-2.0% in chop, leverage neutral, mid realized vol with options rich to RV; spot ETF net outflow narrowed to -228.40M, channel neutral/tug-of-war.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 -2.28 亿美金

risk.zh: IV 对 RV 仍有约 11.5 点溢价，拥挤度不高但清算峰落在周中，若波动再抬需防期权端定价与现货节奏脱节；杠杆读法：盯拥挤线（费率路径+OI）与出清线（2026-10-15 峰是否双高、次日是否退烧）。
risk.en: IV still ~11.5 pts over RV; crowding mild but mid-week liq peak—watch options pricing drift from spot rhythm if vol re-lifts; Leverage read: crowding (funding path+OI) and flush (2026-10-15 peak dual-high? next-day cool-down?).

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 中性通道是否续缩流出、IV-RV 溢价能否收敛，以及偏震荡是否被永续量能打断。
watch.en: Watch whether ETF neutral channel keeps shrinking outflows, IV-RV premium compresses, and chop holds against perp activity.

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口约 -2.0% 与 ES 几乎同幅，但 NQ 更深回撤、VIX 大涨，黄金与美元仅小幅波动；标签落在「加密偏独立」——价格路径未简单镜像科技股，却也未走出独立强势。
compare.en: BTC’s ~-2.0% window matched ES in size while NQ sold off harder and VIX jumped; gold and DXY barely moved. Label is crypto-idiosyncratic: path did not mirror tech, nor print a clean independent bid.

path.zh: 趋势标签偏震荡：周内缺少单边延伸，收在温和下跌区间；相对上周 -3.2% 的更深回撤，本周跌幅收窄，更像消化而非趋势加速。
path.en: Trend tag chop: little one-way extension, closed in a mild down band. Versus last week’s deeper -3.2%, the drawdown narrowed—more digestion than trend acceleration.

leverage.zh:
标签：杠杆中性。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +0.64%/yr → 期末约 +5.43%/yr，租金全周抬升；OI 周变约 +0.81%（92374 → 93123），全周库存仅略变——更像摩擦期，而非匀速大拆/大堆杠杆。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 10-15（2026-10-15）；峰值约 2.33× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 +0.7%；当日 OI 约 94171；但 OI 周高在 2026-10-17（约 94260），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日上升，偏改仓/挤压结构而非单纯慢速拆仓。次日 2026-10-16：OI 自峰值日回落至约 94052、funding 年化约 +10.95%/yr、价格约 -0.8%。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 782.10 亿美金，环比约 +9.2%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线与出清线并读 → 清算峰相对中位偏温和、峰值日并非 OI 周高（无「清算∥OI 双高」）、量旁证偏淡，共同支撑「杠杆中性」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。
leverage.en:
Label: leverage_neutral.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+0.64%/yr → ~+5.43%/yr — rent rose over the week; OI week change ~+0.81% (92374 → 93123), inventory barely moved — friction week, not steady build/unwind.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-10-15; peak ~2.33× median liq qty; price that day ~+0.7%; OI that day ~94171; OI week-high was 2026-10-17 (~94260), not a dual-high peak day; OI up vs prior day — reposition/squeeze structure more than slow unwind. Next day 2026-10-16: OI eased to ~94052; funding ~+10.95%/yr; price ~-0.8%.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~78.21B, WoW ~+9.2%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: crowding + flush lines → liq peak mild vs median; peak day ≠ OI week-high (no liq∥OI dual-high); volume side quieter — supports “leverage_neutral”; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎 -2.28 亿美金（流入 2 日、流出 3 日，单日极值约 +1.76 亿与 -2.61 亿），通道标签中性/拉锯；较上周约 -6.79 亿流出明显收窄。ETH ETF 同期约 -3.20 亿。并陈 Binance 口径现货成交额周合计约 83.12 亿美金、环比 +1.2%（正常），总量热闹度平稳，不与 ETF 净流加总、不拆多空。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net -228.40M (2 inflow / 3 outflow days; day extremes ~+175.7M / -261.4M), channel neutral/tug-of-war—narrower than last week’s ~-679M. ETH ETF ~-320.10M. Alongside, spot exchange turnover ~8.31B, +1.2% WoW (normal); activity level steady—do not sum with ETF net or split side.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 83.12 亿美金，相对上完整周 +1.2%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 82.13 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-10-15（18.37 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 782.10 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 8.31B, vs prior full week +1.2% (activity “normal”; prior ~8.21B). Peak day 2026-10-15 (1.84B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (78.21B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 中等 RV 配上仍偏富的 IV，意味期权市对尾部或路径不确定性定价高于刚走过的实现波动；在震荡周里，这种溢价常反映保险需求未退，而非已确认的趋势波动。
vol_teach.en: Mid RV with still-rich IV means options are pricing path/tail uncertainty above what just realized; in a chop week that often flags lingering hedge demand, not confirmed trend vol.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 27.4%（中等），期末 IV 约 38.8%，IV-RV 点差约 +11.5，标签期权偏贵；ETH 端 RV~39.2%、IV~53.4%，溢价结构类似但更陡。
vol_week.en: BTC RV ~27.4% ann. (mid), IV end ~38.8%, IV-RV spread ~+11.5—options rich vs RV. ETH RV~39.2% / IV~53.4% shows a steeper but similar premium shape.

vol_combo.zh: 波动中等 + 期权偏贵 + 杠杆中性：拥挤与出清压力都不突出，但保险偏贵，适合把「波动是否被高估」当作观察轴，而不是当作单边方向信号。
vol_combo.en: Mid vol + rich options + neutral leverage: neither crowding nor washout dominates, yet insurance is expensive—treat ‘is vol overpriced’ as the axis, not a directional green light.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格温和下跌、IV 仍高于 RV：下跌并未系统性压掉隐含溢价，说明期权端对续跌或跳空的戒备仍在，与现货「偏震荡」标签并存。
vol_price_iv.en: Mild price down while IV stays above RV: the dip did not systematically crush the implied premium—options still guard gap/continuation risk alongside the chop label.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 窗口大涨约 +34.7%，与加密「中等实现波动、偏独立」形成对照：传统风险偏好受压更明显，加密波动标签并未同步升级到高波。
vol_vix.en: VIX window ~+34.7% contrasts crypto’s mid RV and idiosyncratic tag—TradFi risk appetite compressed harder; crypto vol label did not step up to high-vol in lockstep.

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元略弱可作弱背景，不是主引擎。
vs_crypto.en: Mild USD softness is backdrop, not the main engine.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号内 ES 约 -2.0%、NQ 约 -5.5%，VIX 大涨，美债收益率下行约 14.6 bp，美元与黄金小幅回落；加密价格跌幅更近 ES 而非 NQ，联动标签落在加密偏独立。
tradfi_summary.en: In the US Fri–Fri bracket ES ~-2.0%, NQ ~-5.5%, VIX sharply up, US10Y ~-14.6 bp, DXY and gold slightly softer. Crypto’s drawdown tracked ES more than NQ—link tag crypto-idiosyncratic.

three_conclusions.zh: 价格与杠杆：BTC 约 -2% 偏震荡、OI 微增、资金费率温和正、杠杆中性——下跌未演变成拥挤出清主剧。
three_conclusions.en: Price & leverage: BTC ~-2% chop, OI slightly up, funding mildly positive, leverage neutral—the dip did not become a crowding-washout main act.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道：BTC ETF 净流出收窄至 -2.28 亿、通道中性拉锯，现货成交额约 83 亿美金环比近持平；与永续约 782 亿、+9% 的热闹度并陈，不焊因果。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel: BTC ETF net outflow narrowed to -228.40M (neutral tug-of-war), spot turnover ~8.31B nearly flat WoW; set beside perp ~78.21B (+9%) activity—no welded causality.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动定价：RV 中等而 IV 偏贵（点差约 +11.5），叠加 VIX 大涨、加密联动偏独立——传统避险升温并未同步把加密实现波动打成高波标签。
three_conclusions.en: Vol pricing: mid RV with rich IV (~+11.5 pts), VIX surge, crypto idiosyncratic—TradFi hedge bid rose without flipping crypto’s realized-vol tag to high.

text.zh: ETF 中性/拉锯是否延续：下期 BTC 现货 ETF 周净流是否仍落在小幅净流出或翻成净流入区间。
text.en: Does ETF neutral/tug-of-war persist: next week’s BTC spot ETF net still mild outflow or flip toward net inflow.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周流出已较上周大幅收窄且通道中性，是核对「压力是否真正缓和」的最直接哨。

text.zh: IV 相对 RV 是否仍偏贵：期末 IV-RV 点差能否从约 +11.5 明显收敛，或溢价继续悬挂。
text.en: IV still rich vs RV?: does end IV-RV spread compress from ~+11.5 or stay elevated.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周核心矛盾之一是中等实现波动配偏贵期权，值得作为下期定价松紧的核对项。

text.zh: 偏震荡是否被打断：BTC 是否仍缺单边延伸，或永续成交与 OI 路径出现趋势化抬头。
text.en: Chop intact?: BTC still lacks one-way extension, or perp turnover/OI path starts to trend.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 跌幅收窄且趋势标签震荡，若量能与 OI 同步趋势化，叙事会从消化切到方向选择。

matched.zh: 偏震荡 + 中等波动 + 杠杆中性，使均值回归类路径更贴合本周节奏；IV 相对 RV 偏贵则让波动收割（卖贵保险、注意保证金与尾部）在结构上对得上，但仅解释匹配、非推荐。
matched.en: Chop + mid vol + neutral leverage aligns mean-reversion-style paths with the week’s rhythm; IV rich to RV structurally fits vol-harvest framing (expensive insurance, mind tails/margin)—match explanation only, not a recommendation.

mismatched.zh: 趋势跟随与「偏震荡、跌幅收窄、无清晰单边延伸」相悖，本周缺少可持续的方向惯性作为该框架的主燃料。
mismatched.en: Trend-following clashes with chop, a narrowed drawdown, and no clean one-way extension—the week lacked durable directional inertia that framework needs.
